name: knife_edge_beam

fixed.description: left pin — knife-edge line (x=-60, z=0), ux+uy+uz
right roller — bottom line at x=+60, uz only (x free)

source: 3-point bending on NODE-EXACT knife-edge supports (plane regions): pin = ux+uy+uz on the left edge line, roller = uz-only on the right line (x_range clip). EB delta=FL^3/48EI=0.297mm + Timoshenko shear FL/4kGA=0.0097 -> 0.307mm (L=120, I=3456mm4, k=5/6, G=1286.8MPa). sigma_x top fibre at x=10 = -M(50)*5/I = -2500*5/3456 = -3.615 MPa; bottom mid fibre +4.34 MPa.
notes: Measured @ pitch 2: delta=0.312 (+1.6%), sigma_x(10,0,11)=-3.59. Knife-edge supports are single edge LINES — a cell-band region spans >=2 node planes and measured ~2.4x over-stiff in earlier probing. IMPORTANT: pinning ux on BOTH lines (fix_mode all twice) doubles the stiffness via membrane restraint (immovable supports) — a textbook roller must leave the axial DOF free, hence the '-z' + x_range single-DOF region on the right.
